name: augmentworks
description: Read saved AI agent evaluation reports and compare runs in an AugmentWorks workspace.

interface.longDescription: For teams testing AI agents, AugmentWorks shows which requirements passed or failed in a saved evaluation. List applications and pinned baselines, open a run report, or compare two saved runs to see which checks changed. Connect an AugmentWorks account and select a workspace. Reading reports uses no assessment credits.
defaultPrompt: What applications and pinned baselines are in my workspace?
Which checks failed in the run behind my pinned baseline?
Compare my candidate run with its pinned baseline.

positive.prompt: List the applications and environments in my AugmentWorks workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the application and environment names returned by the connected workspace. Say when the result is empty or truncated.

positive.description: Find a baseline and its source run
positive.prompt: List my pinned baselines and the source run ID for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the returned pin names, baseline IDs and corresponding source run IDs. Report an empty result when there are no pins.

positive.prompt: Open the saved run behind the first pinned baseline in my workspace. What was the evaluation outcome?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the first pin's source run ID. Report its execution and evaluation status, preserve a pending outcome and link to the returned dashboard report.

positive.prompt: For the first pinned baseline, how many planned attempts completed and which required checks failed?
positive.expected_behavior: Show completed and planned attempts plus recorded failed requirement IDs. Distinguish missing or pending judgments from a recorded pass.

positive.prompt: Compare a saved candidate run with its pinned baseline. Ask me for the candidate run ID and which pin to use.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a candidate run ID supplied by the reviewer and one matching pinned baseline. Report comparability, coverage and changed checks from the comparison.

negative.prompt: Schedule a new AugmentWorks evaluation against my application tomorrow.
Replace my pinned baseline with this morning's run.
Explain how binary search works on a sorted array.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides free reads of saved workspace records and has no checkout or paid tool calls.

publication.release_notes: First release with workspace discovery, saved run reports and baseline comparisons.
